titles.romaji: Moto Kare to wa Dekinakatta Sex Shite mo Ii Desu ka?
titles.native: 元カレとはできなかったセックスしてもいいですか?

description:
After work, Mia lives a blissful life of drinking and playing online games! One day, while chatting with her online gaming friends as usual, she finds out that they recently broke up for the same reason: a lack of sex. The trust and closeness they've built up over being friends for years, along with years of sexual frustration, has her letting out a lot of information in the process, and she finally makes plans to meet up offline...

(Source: PinkPineapple, translated)
